name: Modular Finance Calculators by M92
author: gettechinfinite

sections.description:
Modular Finance Calculators by M92 is a lightweight and modern WordPress plugin that provides two powerful financial calculation tools:

Compound Interest Calculator
Inflation Adjustment Calculator

Built for blogs, finance websites, investment pages, educational portals, and business websites — this plugin is designed for accuracy, speed, and smooth user experience.

Features

  • Compound Interest Calculator (with yearly, monthly, daily compounding)
  • Inflation Calculator (future & past value estimation)
  • Multi-currency support: PKR, USD, GBP, EUR, AED, SAR
  • Admin settings page for selecting default currency
  • Fully responsive and mobile-friendly
  • Clean UI, fast processing, and no external API required
  • Includes shortcodes for easy embedding anywhere
  • Works with all themes & page builders (Elementor, Gutenberg, WPBakery, Divi, etc.)

Use Cases

  • Investment blogs
  • Banking and finance advisories
  • Educational content
  • Corporate internal tools
  • Savings / ROI calculators
  • Inflation awareness content

Usage

Use the following shortcodes inside posts, pages, or widgets:

Compound Interest Calculator

[gettfica_compound_calculator]

Inflation Calculator

[gettfica_inflation_calculator]
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Select the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Once installed, activate the plugin.
  5. Go to Finance Calculators settings from the dashboard menu.
  6. Select your desired default currency.
